WITH rating_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    rating,
    AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost,
    AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS avg_daily_rental_price
  FROM film
  GROUP BY rating
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_daily_rental_price) AS overall_daily_avg
  FROM rating_stats
)
SELECT 
  rs.rating,
  rs.avg_replacement_cost,
  rs.avg_daily_rental_price,
  rs.avg_daily_rental_price / oa.overall_daily_avg AS price_to_overall_ratio
FROM rating_stats rs
CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
ORDER BY rs.rating;
